brief: Today's news is marked by a devastating earthquake in Colombia, escalating global heatwaves and wildfires, and political controversies from immigration reform to surveillance. Meanwhile, research spans from AI in finance to practical engineering solutions.

papers_summary: Research includes AI-driven financial forecasting, IoT flood monitoring, and seismic vulnerability assessment, alongside studies on music identification from brain activity and HLA matching.
